classification_vocabulary.exact: The imported field or artifact matches the pinned current repository fact in the audited scope.
classification_vocabulary.supported: The repository supports the statement, but it is not an exact or complete projection.
classification_vocabulary.contradicted: Current repository evidence directly disproves the imported statement or runtime disposition.
classification_vocabulary.external-only: The item is governed by an external catalog or registry and cannot be established from repository bytes alone.
classification_vocabulary.stale: The artifact or evidence is bound to a non-current source revision or superseded README.
classification_vocabulary.partial: Some fields are correct, but material omissions, mixed scopes, or count inconsistencies remain.
classification_vocabulary.missing: A required artifact or field is absent.
classification_vocabulary.unprovable: The available evidence does not support a decisive truth judgment.

systemic_causes.finding: It scans only bundle_manifest.json. Note/Python and Barcode/Python have no bundle manifest, so their stale promoted knowledge is invisible to this detector.
systemic_causes.smallest_repair: Enumerate every merged/model.yaml, synthesize member hashes when bundle_manifest.json is absent, and compare each target repository's live default-branch SHA to model.repo_sha.
systemic_causes.minimum_test: A manifest-less bundle with a changed live SHA must appear as stale and block promotion.

systemic_causes.finding: A claim becomes corroborated when any evidence file merely exists. Line, excerpt, symbol, method body and polarity are ignored.
systemic_causes.smallest_repair: Require an evidence adapter by claim kind that validates path + line/symbol + content/polarity; existence alone can mean only 'located', never 'verified'.
systemic_causes.minimum_test: The existing PDF file containing raise NotImplementedError must reject positive PDF-export claims while retaining the limitation.

systemic_causes.finding: Every uncorroborated claim is output-eligible when the bundle SHA is current. This admits stale carried-forward enriched evidence and unsupported prose at confidence 0.6.
